## False Positive / False Negative Risk Assessment

| Engine | Known FP risk | Known FN risk | Mitigations in place |
|--------|--------------|--------------|----------------------|
| security_headers | CSP set via meta tag (not header) | None known | Evidence records response headers only |
| cookies | Session cookie named generically as "sensitive" | Httponly set in JS after load | Passive header analysis only |
| tls_checker | CDN-terminated TLS — scanner sees CDN cert | Weak ciphers negotiated by CDN only | Provider flag on findings |
| dns_checker | Shared CDN IP → takeover candidate FP | DNSSEC via upstream resolver | takeover_candidate: CNAME + dangling record required |
| threat_intel | Shared CDN IPs (Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 etc.) | TI feeds offline in CI | Shared-IP suppression list; offline graceful degrade |
| js_analyzer | Minified code triggers `eval`/`innerHTML` patterns | Dynamic code loaded post-page | Inline-only analysis; external scripts not fetched |
| obfuscation_detector | Legitimate packer (UglifyJS) triggers `packer` check | Server-side obfuscation | THEORETICAL exploitability on most checks |
| sensitive_paths | WAF 403 on all paths gives false negatives | All paths behind auth | HEAD → GET fallback; 200 only counts as found |
| threat_intel (TI match) | Shared CDN → HIGH severity FP | CDN miss on novel malware C2 | THEORETICAL exploitability default; CDN-IP suppression |
| compromise detection | GTM-injected scripts trigger `injected_js` | Server-side injection not visible | Provider allowlist; whitelist of known tag managers |
| endpoint_discovery | Any `/api/` path flagged without auth probe | Auth-gated endpoints not visible | Severity calibrated to MEDIUM; no active probe |

## Engine Execution Model

All engines operate on one of two input contracts:

1. **Pre-extracted artifacts** (`PageArtifacts`) — already extracted by the crawler/extractor, no network I/O:  
   `js_analyzer`, `obfuscation_detector`, `third_party_domains`, `form_discovery`, `form_risk`, `input_analysis`, `technology`, `hidden_iframes`, `injected_js`, `seo_spam`, `suspicious_redirects`, `secret_scanner`, `external_domains`, `endpoint_discovery`, `wordpress`, `shopify`, `wix`

2. **Active HTTP** (safe-mode GET/HEAD only, rate-limited, scope-checked):  
   `sensitive_paths`, `robots_sitemap`, `tls_checker`, `dns_checker`, `source_map_probe`

3. **Composition** (reads results of other engines):  
   `provider_discovery` (reads TechnologyEngine findings + DNS results)  
   `wade_correlation` (reads ScanFingerprint history from DB)

**Orchestrator guarantees:** engine errors are isolated (one failure never aborts the scan). Max pages, max depth, rate limits are always enforced. GET/HEAD only — no POST/PUT/DELETE, no JS execution, no form submission.
